doc.title: Frank Wess interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995

title: The special Army band
summary: The band had special authorization and recruited professional musicians exempt from basic training.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: This is while you’re still in the service?

Well we had a big band. We had special authorization for 55 pieces, and the Army band was only 28. But our band leader was a friend of President Roosevelt’s. So we had special authorization and he used to recruit professional musicians who were on the road and about to be drafted. And he had a deal where if you came into the band with him, you didn’t have to take any basic training, and you got a rating the first day you came in. So you know, we never did anything but play music. That was it. So we didn’t have to go through all that other stuff.
